$comment: Local model used by the Ollama/Telegram vault assistant (03_IMPLEMENTATION/packages/vault_access/ollama_assistant.py). num_ctx is ALWAYS sent explicitly on the native /api/chat endpoint: Ollama's default context is chosen by VRAM tier (4096 tokens under 24 GiB) and silently drops the start of a longer prompt, which is how llama3.1:8b came to 'read' a VAULT_STATE.md it never saw. The OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint cannot set num_ctx and is not used. Change `model` to any local model that fits your GPU; the pipeline does not trust the model to choose files or to quote correctly.
